entry.title: dYdX Switches USDC Deposits From Noble to Injective
entry.summary: Existing trading balances and positions stay unchanged as dYdX gradually replaces Noble backing ahead of Circle’s January cutoff.

entry.title: xStocks' Anthropic Token Starts Trading on Solana
entry.summary: ANTx provides share-backed price exposure, not shareholder rights. xStocks announced trading after reporting it could not fill all IPO Access requests.

entry.title: Jito's JTO Falls 46% in 28 Days, Lagging BTC and ETH
entry.summary: JTO lost about 21% over seven days, compared with roughly 12% for bitcoin and 11% for ether. Jito's dollar-denominated fees also softened.

entry.title: Wallet Supplies 1.49 Billion USDC to Aave, Cutting Rates
entry.summary: Three deposits into Aave’s Ethereum V3 market increased USDC supply to about 4.24 billion and lowered borrowing costs and lender returns.

entry.title: Binance Wallet Announces Anthropic IPO Token Refunds
entry.summary: Binance Wallet says the campaign's roughly 2,957-token allocation will be given away, with an added $1 million ANTB airdrop, after subscriptions hit a 500 million USDC cap.

entry.title: Ondo Launches 24/7 Anthropic Token on IPO Day
entry.summary: ANTon offers eligible non-US investors round-the-clock minting and redemption, but holders own share-backed notes rather than Anthropic shares.

entry.title: Backpack's Anthropic Token Debuts on Solana on IPO Day
entry.summary: A Meteora ANT-USDC pool held about $1.06 million in assets shortly after noon ET. The wallet-held token is not a Nasdaq share, and access excludes US persons.

entry.title: Lido DAO Votes on Framework for Its Lending Protocol
entry.summary: Vote #207 would approve committees and market-management tools. Individual lending markets would still need separate approval, mainly through motions LDO holders can block.

entry.title: MoonPay Seeks US Trust Bank for Custody, Stablecoins
entry.summary: The proposed Miami Beach bank would issue and redeem stablecoins and manage reserves. Its OCC application remains pending.

entry.title: United Bars Personal AI Agents From Booking Flights
entry.summary: The November 11 restrictions reach travel agencies and aggregators as well as United’s own platforms, even when passengers authorize an agent.

entry.title: Selig Says US Retail Onchain Perps Need Regulated Exchanges
entry.summary: Asked about Hyperliquid, the CFTC chair cited Backpack and said to 'stay tuned' on other protocols, according to The Block.

entry.title: xStocks Says It Can't Meet All Anthropic IPO Access Demand
entry.summary: xStocks said unfilled funds will be released without fees. Kraken's terms charge a 5% spread on allocations customers receive.

entry.title: PHP Patches Critical Code-Execution Flaw Rated 9.2
entry.summary: The bug affects PHP's default file-based session storage. Code execution requires attacker influence over session data, an interrupted write and suitable application code.

entry.title: Bundesbank and MAS Test Proof-Based Euro-SGD Settlement
entry.summary: Project Simbolon coordinated payments without a direct link between central bank ledgers, but used simulated money rather than a live settlement service.

entry.title: Marin Opens 57 Mochi AI Checkpoints for Researchers
entry.summary: The 535-billion-parameter model's training snapshots carry a permissive license, but they are not ready-to-deploy assistants.

entry.title: Most Institutional Bidders Got No Anthropic IPO Shares: Bloomberg
entry.summary: Allocations favored US-based investors, Bloomberg reported, even as the Claude developer expanded its offering to 980 million shares at $83 each.

entry.title: Bitcoin Holds Above Weekend Low on Coinbase Amid False Price Alerts
entry.summary: CoinMarketCap acknowledged incorrect bitcoin-price notifications, sometimes sent more than once, and said it was investigating the cause.

entry.title: AI Agent Security: Why Refusals Are Not Access Controls
entry.summary: Hostile documents can steer a tool-using AI toward actions its user never requested. Permissions and meaningful approval checks limit the consequences.

entry.title: Securitize Plans IPO-Day Anthropic Tokens on Solana
entry.summary: The platform's share-backed stock model includes eligible US investors. Live trading in its planned ANT token was not independently confirmed.

entry.title: How to Read Prediction-Market Odds in a News Headline
entry.summary: An odds percentage is a price-based forecast, not a poll or confirmation. The contract’s rules, quote method and timestamp explain what it measures.

entry.title: Coinbase Opens Crypto Options to Eligible Non-US Users
entry.summary: The Deribit-powered contracts settle in USDC and are available through Coinbase's standard interface and Advanced. US retail users are excluded.

entry.summary: Fluid offers USDC borrowing against hBTC, while Anchorage Digital's Porto provides institutional access. BitGo is expected in 2027.

entry.summary: Chainlink says the pilot demonstrated automated note servicing on Ethereum through CRE. Digital-money settlement integration remains future work.

entry.title: edgeX to End Principal Protection for $13.5M Vault
entry.summary: Depositors must accept the new profit-and-loss-sharing terms by 11 p.m. ET on Nov. 26 or have funds returned to their futures accounts.

entry.summary: Inca Digital identified $518 million in historical illicit-linked PSM activity, including $101.9 million tied to North Korean actors, CoinDesk reported.

entry.title: MAS Plans SG Digital Ledger and 'Know Your Agent' Protocol
entry.summary: The settlement network has already handled live transactions. The AI-agent protocol remains development work, alongside a planned treasury and payments sandbox.

entry.title: 1inch Brings Hyperliquid Perps to Wallet and Web App
entry.summary: Eligible users can fund positions by swapping supported tokens into USDC. Wallet access is Android-only, and the service excludes the US and other restricted jurisdictions.

entry.summary: The post-mortem traces the loss to unused token-spending permissions in K3's vault. Liquity said its underlying protocol was unaffected.

entry.title: Trump Media Buys Back $100 Million in Note Principal
entry.summary: About $883.5 million of notes remain subject to a Nov. 30 cash-repayment right as management seeks to preserve bitcoin.

entry.title: Amber Group Redirects Resources to AI, Adjusts Trading
entry.summary: The crypto market maker said some staff have been affected by a strategy shift toward AI investment and startup incubation.

entry.summary: DZ BANK bought the bond using the Eurosystem’s Pontes pilot. The banks said the transaction finished in less than an hour.

entry.summary: Sales to external customers grew 64%, while AI-related product revenue reached $2.67 billion using Alibaba's currency conversion.

entry.summary: METR estimates Anthropic's benchmark progress has nearly doubled in pace. OpenAI reports higher estimated task-success rates without human intervention, with wide variation by task.

entry.summary: The regulator names Hyperliquid's trading website and warns investors that unlicensed platforms are not under its supervision.

entry.summary: SKY has lost about 38% over four weeks, compared with bitcoin's 22% decline. Sky's TVL and USDS circulating supply have also fallen further.

entry.summary: DBS and Franklin Templeton joined the pilot of a protocol designed to link cash payments to fund-share issuance and redemption across separate ledgers.

entry.summary: SNIP-45 would let delegators reclaim or redirect their votes in one transaction. The governance vote is scheduled for Nov. 27 to Dec. 4.

entry.summary: Twelve transfers made up the largest of three daily batches, but the transactions were wallet-to-wallet movements, not bitcoin swaps.

entry.summary: Hong Kong retail customers can invest from HK$100 through the bank’s mobile app in a new share class of an existing money market fund.

entry.summary: COTI urged holders to act by the Dec. 31 cutoff and withdraw any tokens deposited in DeFi first. About 1 million DJED remain in circulation.

entry.summary: The live auction drew applications for more than twice the issuance size. MAS plans to scale up issuance and broaden use of the bills as collateral.

entry.summary: Positions left open will settle at a time-weighted average price from market launch through the halt, rather than at the final traded price.

entry.summary: A forum analysis warns that BEP-706's sample code could let expired quotes pass a timing check if its timestamp call succeeds but returns no data.

entry.summary: Intel's technology chief identified the unnamed customer's process as 18A-P. The company had already announced 18A projects with Microsoft and AWS.

entry.summary: TCEQ says normal reviews have resumed after a September directive to pause permit issuance. ERCOT targets Dec. 10 for its final community-impact report.

entry.summary: The agreement also confirms multi-year Xeon capacity, including Diamond Rapids, without naming the Azure chips slated for Intel packaging.

entry.summary: Capital expenditure payments rose 225% as cloud revenue growth accelerated to 35% and WorkBuddy topped 10 million daily users.

entry.summary: The venture firm, chaired by Payward and Kraken co-CEO Arjun Sethi, manages $2.7 billion, Payward says. Closing is expected in early 2027.

entry.summary: GAO says investigators obtained usable information in under 12 hours per platform in spring tests, but the findings cannot rank the chatbots’ safety.

entry.summary: Eligible non-US traders can take USDC-settled positions with up to 5x leverage, without receiving shares or an IPO allocation.

entry.summary: HSP-029 targets a 1.6% issuance cap over 24 months. A quarter-long grace period and separate validator adoption stand between ratification and lower emissions.

entry.summary: Microsoft executives told OpenAI they found no evidence of distillation, The Information says, as ByteDance discusses roughly $500 million more in cloud spending.

entry.summary: Fake pre-orders and airdrops lead to wallet drainers, Blockaid says. Its four-month Solana token count combines malicious verdicts, warnings and spam.

entry.summary: Morning futures pricing on Nov. 18 put a quarter-point hike at 95%, as the Fed governor argued for a larger move unless policymakers clearly signal another increase in January.

entry.summary: The preferred closed 3.9% below its $100 stated amount, limiting new issuance even after $228.1 million of buybacks in the latest reported week.

entry.summary: In single-turn cyber tests, a researcher developed a jailbreak in half the queries needed for GPT-6 Astra. OpenAI changed safeguards, but UK testers had not independently tested the latest changes as of their Nov. 17 account.

entry.summary: Ethereum records show withdrawals of 884,151 USDT and 648 USDC, plus the creation of 22 million WGNK that Blockaid described as unbacked.

entry.summary: The planned market would extend Akash’s compute business as it prepares to move from Cosmos. A separate draft describes fixed-price reservations for future capacity.

entry.summary: The net share of managers overweight tech fell to 12% from 37% in October, Bloomberg reported, while the survey balance remained positive.

entry.title: Bessent Points to Commerce in Megaspeed Blacklist Split
entry.summary: The Treasury secretary said four agencies backed listing Megaspeed for months. Commerce and Justice say a criminal investigation is continuing.

entry.summary: Developers will discuss whether to change rules that can alter how existing contracts handle failed operations. Glamsterdam’s activation on Hoodi remains on hold.

entry.summary: Institutions can pledge bitcoin and stablecoins without moving the crypto to the trading venue, Anchorage says. Custody does not remove liquidation risk.

entry.summary: The financing backs PRIMA’s European rollout and a planned US launch that still requires FDA approval.

entry.summary: ZDAY trades on NYSE Arca with a 0.75% annual expense ratio and 16 holdings, led by Palo Alto Networks and CrowdStrike.

entry.summary: New Yorkers can borrow USDC against bitcoin, ether and SOL, but fixed-rate loans and the broader collateral menu remain unavailable in the state.

entry.summary: The restrictions took effect Nov. 11 and require corrective action before freeway service can resume, KRON4 reported. Waymo says surface-street rides continue.

entry.summary: The workbench pairs MuJoCo simulation with camera-guided control. Antigravity access requires a paid Google AI Pro or Ultra subscription.

entry.summary: The grid operator wants to combine studies of new power plants and large electricity users, but data center groups warn its annual entry window could add delays.

entry.summary: OKX Wallet advertises up to 350,000 USDC in launch incentives, including an xStocks-sponsored bonus for depositing eligible stock-token collateral.

entry.summary: K3 Capital said it paused contracts as Blockaid reported losses from its sBOLD vault on Ethereum and a separate stablecoin drain on Polygon.

entry.summary: The token's slide outpaced bitcoin and ether as Curve reported lower trading fees and veCRV payouts in its Nov. 13 weekly update.

entry.title: Polymarket US Says It Is Adding Oil and Gas Markets
entry.summary: The company reports more than 300,000 short-duration crypto traders in six weeks. Energy filings describe price-threshold bets, with listing planned no earlier than Nov. 19.

entry.title: NEAR Says Take-Two–Linked Token Is Live on Near.com
entry.summary: The TTWO product is an Assetize debt certificate, not ownership of Take-Two shares. NEAR advertises round-the-clock, confidential trading.

entry.summary: CNBC reported pricing above the $70–$78 range, while Bloomberg said the offering had increased in size. Anthropic had not posted final terms on its IPO website.

entry.summary: CZ named bStocks, Ondo and xStocks as routes to IPO-day exposure. Their products track shares but do not give holders direct equity ownership.

entry.summary: Access is limited to eligible contract participants—a standard that generally requires individuals to have more than $10 million invested on a discretionary basis.

entry.summary: Standard paid API rates are $3 per million uncached input tokens and $15 per million output tokens. Access is also rolling out to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.

entry.summary: Ledger's UAE reseller directory lists Virgin Megastores' Ledger sales as temporarily paused, while investigator ZachXBT presses the company over compensation.

entry.summary: The Nov. 18 quote was 4.3% below the recovery The Defiant documented Sunday, but still above Saturday's four-month low.

entry.summary: The fix updates the web-server dependency, not BTCPay's own version number. Docker operators should verify that their nginx container runs 1.31.9.

entry.summary: Bitcoin and ether slipped on Coinbase in the 10 minutes after the release. The October record showed broad support for further tightening, conditional on the economic outlook.

entry.summary: Binance says it is pursuing frozen assets after committing more than $6.34 billion in company funds to cover losses from the hack.

entry.summary: In Artificial Analysis’ Max-setting tests, Astra leads GDP.pdf and Fable leads a factual-question net score that penalizes wrong answers. Neither establishes a winner for live research or reliable citations.

entry.summary: Bitcoin’s low was about 0.4% above its weekend trough on Coinbase. Citi strategist Alex Saunders lowered the bank’s base-case target to $99,532, CNBC reported.

entry.title: EIGEN Falls 48% in Four Weeks, Lagging Bitcoin, Ether
entry.summary: EigenCloud's restaking collateral was valued at $4.52 billion, down about 28.5% from an Oct. 21 snapshot.

entry.title: Variational Raises $110 Million to Expand Omni Trading
entry.summary: Bain Capital Crypto led the round at a $1.5 billion valuation. Variational plans higher trading limits and more traditional-asset markets.

entry.title: US Capital-Goods Import Prices Post Record Monthly Rise
entry.summary: Bitcoin slipped 0.2% across the release hour. Futures still pointed to higher rates into March, even though the implied average rate for March edged down at Tuesday's settlement.

entry.summary: The futures intermediary approval follows CFTC exchange and clearinghouse orders. American customers still face a waitlist, not an open trading venue.

entry.summary: Repository answers, code edits and terminal jobs call for different tests. Here’s how to compare scores, spending and completion time.

entry.summary: Directly held bank cash fell to $9.50 billion at September-end as total backing edged higher. The snapshots show a changed reserve mix but don’t establish whether redemption capacity changed.
